articles.title: MetOp-SG-B1 weather satellite arrives at Europe’s Spaceport
articles.summary: Following a 10-day voyage across the Atlantic from Bordeaux in France, the MetOp Second Generation-B1 weather satellite, has arrived at Europe’s Spaceport in French Guiana. After a short storage period, this new satellite will be prepared for launch aboard an Ariane 6 rocket, expected at the end of the year.

articles.title: Sentinel-3C captures Hurricane Rachel
